consequence.statement: Environments that rely on Log Config will have that log configuration no longer honoured after upgrading to v1.0.0; log output configuration must be moved to the newly added Log Paths mechanism.
consequence.remediation: Replace Log Config configuration with the new Log Paths mechanism introduced in #6586.

assertion.statement: The v1.0.0 release notes state that Karpenter drops support for Log Config (it is no longer honoured) and adds Log Paths (PR #6586).

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names the subject only as 'Log Config' without identifying which configuration surface (Helm values key, CLI flag, env var, or config file key) or exact key name it refers to.; applicability: The evidence names only 'Log Config' by feature name and does not state the Helm values key, CLI flag, environment variable, or config file key that implements it, so no exposure predicate over configuration can be written (not a runtime-behavior question).
